patients.title: Alpha - Initial nutrition review (10 Oct 2026)
sections: Case and visit
ALPHA-DEMO-2026. Fictional 58-year-old adult with resected colorectal cancer, receiving adjuvant systemic treatment. Initial outpatient nutrition review: 10 October 2026.
Measurements
Recorded weight: 64.2 kg on 10 October 2026. Previous weight: 68.0 kg on 1 September 2026. Height: 1.68 m. These are dated observations; the earlier weight is not a correction of the current value.
Food intake and symptoms

The patient reports reduced appetite, early satiety and intermittent nausea around treatment days. Small, cool meals are easier to tolerate than large hot meals. The preferred snack is lactose-free plain yogurt.
Reported nutrition routine
The patient reports two oral nutritional supplement cartons daily. The brand, carton volume and protein content were not recorded, so their nutrient contribution cannot be calculated from this note.
Daily context and follow-up

The patient remains independent with usual daily activities; a relative helps with shopping and meal preparation. A repeat weight and intake review is scheduled for 13 October. No medication changes are specified in this summary.
Information not available
Measured energy intake, renal function, albumin, body-composition measurements and a formal allergy history are not available in this visit summary.
